name: As Val
designation: AS Val 9x39mm integrally suppressed special-purpose assault rifle
operating_principle: The AS Val operates on a gas-operated long-stroke piston system with a rotating bolt, utilizing the 9x39mm subsonic cartridge. The integral suppressor reduces the sound signature of the rifle.

components.description: The barrel group consists of the barrel and integral suppressor, designed for sustained automatic fire with the SP-6 cartridge.
The gas system includes the gas block, tube, and piston, which operate the rotating bolt.
The bolt and bolt carrier group are responsible for chambering and extracting the 9x39mm cartridge.
The receiver and dust cover house the bolt and bolt carrier group, and provide a mounting point for the barrel and handguard.
The fire control group includes the trigger, hammer, sear, and selector, which control the firing of the rifle.
The feed system consists of the magazine and magazine latch, which supply the 9x39mm cartridge to the rifle.
The furniture includes the stock, grip, and handguard, which provide a comfortable and stable platform for the shooter.
The recoil/return spring assembly returns the bolt and bolt carrier group to their forward position after firing.
